step.cmd: In FTS, select the Rejected Transactions Retrieval (MR05) search and do the following:
For the first record that is not yet reviewed, determine if the error code is one of the following:

ul.li: If the error code is 243 or 244, refer to Actioning a rejected transaction — Error codes C243 and C244 . Actioning a rejected transaction — Error codes C243 and C244
If the error code is 725 or 726, refer to Actioning a rejected transaction — Error codes C725 and C726 . Actioning a rejected transaction — Error codes C725 and C726
If the error code is 715, a specialized team corrects it. No further action is required.
For any other error code, go to step 3.

step.cmd: Determine if the record is one of the following:

ul.li: If the record is not one of those listed, go to step 4.
If the record is one of those listed, it is corrected by IPOC. No further action is required for this error. Go to step 16.

step.cmd: Select the 3-digit code to open WECS and view a detailed description of the error. Go to step 5.
Determine if the record is a result of a BCS reject:

ul.li: If yes, the officer who inputs the transaction corrects the error. No further action is required for this error. Go to step 16.

step.cmd: Review and follow the instructions provided in WECS under additional information. Based on the WECS information, determine if the rejected transaction can be corrected by a Level 1 officer:
In FTS, determine if a registration number exists for the rejected transaction:

ul.li: If a registration number exists, go to step 8.

If there is no registration number, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to automatically generate an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate or 93- Manual pay system .
Work type: Select 60 - Rejected transaction / or situation not otherwise listed that must be processed via purge and recreate or the Work type appropriate to your situation.
Earnings to be allocated: Complete the weeks and amounts, if required.
Remarks line 1: Enter the EC [CXXX] Enter the exact transaction fields and data to be entered (e.g. BPC __, LRW __, COD __).
Remarks line 4: Type your name and phone number.

step.cmd: To transfer the registration number to IPOC, select the appropriate registration number from the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: Review the rejected information. Re-input the transaction with the correct information. If necessary, refer to the appropriate procedure to resolve the issue.
Determine if a letter is required for the rejected transaction.
In ACS, create and send the appropriate letter for the rejected transaction.
In FTS, remove the SIN from the Rejected Transactions Retrieval (MR05) screen as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the appropriate SIN.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if a WI exists for the rejected transaction:

ul.li: If yes, complete the WI and go to step 16.

step.cmd: Determine if there is another record for the SCC number that is not yet reviewed:

ul.li: If no, no further action is required.
